title: Understanding the 7 Pharmacy Roles & Permission Safeguards

intro.title: 7 Pharmacy Roles & Permission Safeguards
intro.subtitle: Enforce strict role-based access control and audit integrity

narration.text: Welcome to Part 4. In a licensed pharmacy, statutory compliance requires strict role-based access control. MediFlow enforces seven distinct pharmacy roles to protect audit integrity.
narration.caption: Strict statutory compliance: MediFlow enforces 7 dedicated pharmacy roles.

narration.text: In the Staff and Access directory, managers can view all team members, their assigned roles, active branch permissions, and last login timestamps.
narration.caption: View your team directory with assigned roles, branch permissions, and login history.

narration.text: Each role has strict safeguards. Cashiers are restricted to POS billing without seeing wholesale purchase costs, while registered pharmacists approve prescription drugs.
narration.caption: Cashiers focus on POS billing without seeing purchase costs; Pharmacists verify Rx drugs.

narration.text: You can restrict staff to specific branches or grant chain-wide access. In emergencies, instantly suspend a user to revoke their login and active sessions.
narration.caption: Restrict staff to single branches or chain-wide. Instantly suspend users in one click.

narration.text: Clear separation of duties keeps your pharmacy inspection-ready every day. In our final Phase 1 video, we will configure Pharmacy Profiles and GST Rule 46 invoice prefixes.
narration.caption: Audit-ready operations! Watch Part 5 to setup Pharmacy Profiles & GST Rule 46.

outro.takeaway: Statutory Rule: Rule 65 requires Schedule H and X dispensing by a registered pharmacist only.
